_meta.note: Exhaustive data-quality rule registry for the wearable baseline pipeline. Every way upstream data (Terra / HealthKit / Health Connect / vendor clouds) can be wrong, late, duplicated, mis-united, or corrupting — each as a typed rule: detect → action → effect-on-baseline → confidence-impact. The build guard (_baseline_guard) requires every metric to be covered by every applicable category. Principle: NEVER let a bad sample silently move a baseline; quarantine + log + lower Confidence instead of dropping or assuming. Illustrative; re-verify (README §5.6).

rules.name: Time-zone / DST shift
rules.detect: sample tz ≠ profile tz, or a 23/25-hour local day around a DST boundary
rules.action: bucket by the sample's own local time-zone (HKMetadataKeyTimeZone / record zoneOffset); re-derive the local calendar day & sleep-day window
rules.effect: prevents a day being double-counted or split; baseline day-alignment stays correct
rules.conf: none if tz known; lower if tz must be inferred

rules.name: Device clock skew / wrong clock
rules.detect: monotonicity break, or timestamps inconsistent with server receipt time beyond a tolerance
rules.action: trust server-receipt ordering; re-anchor to network time where available; quarantine samples with impossible timestamps
rules.effect: samples excluded from baseline until re-anchored

rules.name: Future-dated sample
rules.detect: timestamp > now + small tolerance
rules.action: quarantine; do not let it become the 'freshest' sample

rules.name: Cross-time-zone travel
rules.detect: tz change between consecutive sleep sessions / large location jump
rules.action: allow a flexible sleep-day window; do not create a phantom zero-sleep or double-sleep day

rules.name: Sleep-day bucketing
rules.detect: sleep session spanning local midnight
rules.action: assign each sleep session to a noon→noon 'sleep day', not a calendar day

rules.name: Missing data (no wear / no sync)
rules.detect: no samples for a metric over an expected interval
rules.action: treat as ABSENT (not zero); shrink n_effective; do not impute into the baseline window
rules.effect: baseline holds last value; spread widens with age

rules.name: Battery died mid-period
rules.detect: abrupt end of intraday samples then resume after a charge gap
rules.action: mark the uncovered window as non-wear; do not extrapolate the partial day to a full day
rules.effect: partial-day aggregates flagged & down-weighted, not counted as a low full-day

rules.name: Permission revoked
rules.detect: a previously-flowing type stops with an authorization-denied signal
rules.action: mark source inactive; fall back to next source; surface a re-grant prompt
rules.effect: switch source or go absent — not a false zero

rules.name: Token expiry / silent feed stop
rules.detect: Terra/vendor webhook silent beyond expected cadence
rules.action: health-check the connection; flag stale; trigger re-auth

rules.name: Incomplete current day
rules.detect: today is in progress / day not yet closed
rules.action: exclude the open day from the baseline window; show 'so far' only in UI, never as a completed low day

rules.name: Non-wear vs sedentary
rules.detect: flat/zero motion + no HR for a block during waking hours
rules.action: classify as non-wear (gate on wear-time); do not count as sedentary or as 0 steps

rules.name: Insufficient history (new user/device)
rules.detect: n_effective < metric min-history
rules.action: use the age×sex×life-stage cohort prior (D33); mark baseline 'provisional'
rules.effect: cohort prior stands in; tightens as history accrues

rules.name: Windowed-index min-history
rules.detect: fewer nights than the index requires (SRI ≥14)
rules.action: withhold the index until min nights; show 'computing'

rules.name: Same metric, multiple sources
rules.detect: >1 active source for a metric
rules.action: apply merge_policy (trust→resolution→recency); pick one canonical series; keep others as corroboration

rules.name: Additive double-counting
rules.detect: overlapping intervals from ≥2 sources on a summed metric (phone+watch steps)
rules.action: choose ONE source per interval before summing; never add across overlapping sources

rules.name: Overlapping intervals
rules.detect: two intervals of the same metric overlap in time
rules.action: merge/clip intervals (union) before aggregating

rules.name: Late historical backfill
rules.detect: samples arriving with old timestamps after their window closed
rules.action: ingest idempotently; reprocess the affected baseline window from raw (recomputable)

rules.name: Webhook replay / duplicate payload
rules.detect: same stable source-id delivered again
rules.action: upsert by source-id; re-delivery is a no-op

rules.name: Multiple sleep sessions / naps
rules.detect: >1 sleep session in a sleep-day
rules.action: sum main + naps per sleep-day per policy; don't treat a nap as a separate short night

rules.name: True zero vs missing-as-zero
rules.detect: a 0 value where the source emits 0 for 'no data'
rules.action: distinguish via wear-time/coverage: 0 with coverage = real (0-step day kept); 0 without coverage = missing (absent)
rules.effect: real zeros inform baseline; fake zeros excluded

rules.name: Implausible / outlier value
rules.detect: outside the metric plausibility gate (e.g. HR>220, SpO₂<70)
rules.action: reject from the baseline-UPDATE (winsorize), keep raw + quarantine-with-context; never let it move μ/σ

rules.name: Real extreme (illness/event)
rules.detect: value extreme but physiologically possible + corroborated (fever + low HRV + high RHR cluster)
rules.action: do NOT discard as noise; exclude from baseline UPDATE but surface as a real deviation/early-warning (Doc 05)

rules.name: Negative value
rules.detect: value < hard floor (negative steps/duration)
rules.action: reject + quarantine; likely counter/parse bug

rules.name: Cumulative counter reset
rules.detect: monotonic cumulative counter (steps) drops to 0 mid-day (device reboot/midnight)
rules.action: reconstruct deltas across the reset; don't read the reset as a real decrease

rules.name: Stuck sensor / flatline
rules.detect: identical value repeated beyond plausible (constant HR/SpO₂)
rules.action: treat the stuck run as non-wear/invalid; exclude

rules.name: Motion artifact
rules.detect: SpO₂/HR sample during high motion / low signal quality flag
rules.action: drop low-quality samples (use the source's confidence/SQI where present)

rules.name: Source unit change
rules.detect: incoming unit ≠ last-known unit for the source/metric
rules.action: re-resolve via units.json transform; if unresolvable → quarantine (never assume)
rules.effect: canonical values stay correct across an upstream unit change

rules.name: Fraction vs percent (SpO₂)
rules.detect: SpO₂ values in [0,1] vs [0,100]
rules.action: scale ×100 when fractional (HealthKit)

rules.name: Temperature unit / absolute-vs-deviation
rules.detect: °F vs °C; absolute temp vs deviation
rules.action: convert to °C; convert absolute→deviation against the same personal baseline before pooling

rules.name: Glucose mg/dL vs mmol/L
rules.detect: CGM values ~70–180 (mg/dL) vs ~3.9–10 (mmol/L)
rules.action: normalise via units.json (×0.0555) before TIR/CV

rules.name: US-locale imperial units
rules.detect: speed in mi/hr, distance in mi (US HealthKit locale)
rules.action: convert to m/s, m

rules.name: Non-comparable definitions
rules.detect: SDNN vs RMSSD; AZM vs MVPA minutes; vendor recovery score vs raw
rules.action: keep as SEPARATE series; never pool; choose one canonical definition; recompute from raw where possible
rules.effect: no silent mixing of incompatible metrics

rules.name: Vendor algorithm divergence
rules.detect: same nominal metric, different vendor algorithm (sleep staging, VO₂max)
rules.action: baseline PER DEVICE/vendor; reset/blend carefully on device switch
rules.effect: no cross-vendor step changes baked into μ

rules.name: Range/score vs point value
rules.detect: source gives a range or composite score (Fitbit VO₂max, AZM)
rules.action: map to a point estimate / raw-equivalent before baselining; document the mapping

rules.name: Device change mid-history
rules.detect: contributing device id changes
rules.action: detect the level shift; start a new device-conditioned baseline and bridge gradually (don't average across the discontinuity)
rules.effect: no phantom drift at the switch

rules.name: Firmware / calibration step-change
rules.detect: abrupt distribution shift coincident with a firmware/app version change
rules.action: treat as a change-point; re-baseline after the shift; flag
rules.effect: baseline tracks the new calibration, not a fake trend

rules.name: Sensor warm-up / unreliable window
rules.detect: CGM first ~hours after insertion; new-wear stabilization
rules.action: exclude the warm-up window

rules.name: Sampling-cadence change
rules.detect: epoch length / sampling frequency changes (battery-saver mode)
rules.action: normalise to a common cadence before aggregating; flag coverage change

rules.name: Insufficient wear-time
rules.detect: wear-time for a day below a metric threshold
rules.action: withhold or down-weight the day's aggregate

rules.name: Upstream schema change
rules.detect: new/removed/renamed field vs known schema
rules.action: ignore unknown fields; degrade missing expected fields to absent; trigger a re-validation pass — never fatal
rules.effect: ingest survives the change; baselines untouched until validated

rules.name: Source schema-version bump
rules.detect: source schema_version changes
rules.action: pin & record version per sample; gate new version through validation before ingest

rules.name: Out-of-order delivery
rules.detect: samples arriving non-chronologically (late webhooks)
rules.action: order by event-time on write; reprocess affected window

rules.name: Unresolvable unit
rules.detect: unit string not in the units registry
rules.action: QUARANTINE — never assume a unit; alert

rules.name: Clinical-grade source gate
rules.detect: a clinical metric (CGM/cuff/HSAT) sourced from a non-validated device
rules.action: do not treat as clinical-grade; tier-down trust or reject for clinical use
rules.effect: clinical baselines only from clinical sources

rules.name: BP systolic/diastolic pairing
rules.detect: separate sys & dia samples
rules.action: pair by timestamp into one reading; never average sys & dia independently

rules.name: Divide-by-zero in derived
rules.detect: denominator 0 (time-in-bed = 0 for efficiency)
rules.action: guard; emit absent rather than Inf/NaN

rules.name: Proprietary score incomparability
rules.detect: vendor composite score (readiness/recovery/strain)
rules.action: do not pool across vendors; recompute an equivalent from raw HR/HRV/sleep where possible, else keep per-vendor

rules.name: Quantization noise floor
rules.detect: Metric values fall on a coarse lattice (integer RHR, 5-min sleep, 1% SpO₂); modal spacing > baseline sensitivity
rules.action: Treat the quantization step as a noise floor: σ = max(observed MAD, step/√12); round deviation thresholds to the lattice
rules.effect: Stops inter-quantum jitter inflating z; stops coarse data hiding real small shifts
rules.conf: cap confidence when effective resolution < metric sensitivity

rules.name: DST fall-back repeated hour
rules.detect: Two distinct samples map to the same wall-clock hour on a fall-back night (regressing local timestamps)
rules.action: Disambiguate by UTC/instant; de-duplicate the repeated 01:00-01:59 hour; prorate interval metrics — never sum both
rules.effect: Prevents a phantom extra hour of sleep/steps twice a year
rules.conf: lower for nights spanning a DST transition

rules.name: Timezone-less (naive) timestamp
rules.detect: Payload timestamp lacks UTC offset/tz, or diurnal alignment is impossible (sleep midpoint at noon)
rules.action: Do NOT assume device/server local; quarantine until tz inferred from companion fields/profile; flag, don't guess
rules.effect: Avoids misassigning a night to the wrong day

rules.name: Provider daily-rollup boundary ≠ our day
rules.detect: Provider daily summary uses a different day boundary (UTC-day, 4am vendor day) than our local/sleep day
rules.action: Prefer re-aggregating intraday samples to our window; if only rollups exist, align boundaries or keep provider-bucketed separate
rules.effect: Removes systematic seam bias in step/MVPA/TIR daily baselines
rules.conf: lower when mixing rollups with intraday re-aggregation

rules.name: Deleted/retracted sample not removed
rules.detect: HKDeletedObject / Health Connect deletion tokens / vendor 'deleted' webhooks tombstone a previously-ingested sample
rules.action: Honour tombstones idempotently: hard-delete the baseline contribution and recompute the affected window from raw
rules.effect: A reading the user/vendor deleted (e.g. an erroneous one) stops permanently skewing μ/EWMA
rules.conf: flag windows that held a now-deleted sample until recomputed

rules.name: User-entered vs sensor-measured
rules.detect: Provenance metadata (HKMetadataKeyWasUserEntered, manual flag) or round human numbers (HR 60, 10000 steps) indicate a typed value
rules.action: Tag manual entries; exclude from sensor baselines (or a separate manual track) — a typed value must never set a sensor metric's baseline
rules.effect: Stops a single guessed value anchoring the baseline
rules.conf: mark contaminated if manual fraction high

rules.name: Multi-user / shared-device contamination
rules.detect: Persistent biometric discontinuity consistent with a different person (shared Withings scale, lent Oura), guest-mode, or bimodal personal distribution
rules.action: Route by user identity; reject readings failing an identity-consistency check; require re-association before contributing
rules.effect: Stops another person's vitals blending into the baseline

rules.name: Demographic change invalidates derived
rules.detect: Profile edit (weight, age rollover, height, sex, max-HR) coincides with a step-change in derived metrics
rules.action: Segment/invalidate derived-metric baselines at the change point; recompute forward; don't blend pre/post-demographic values
rules.effect: Stops a profile edit masquerading as a fitness change
rules.conf: reset confidence for derived metrics at the boundary

rules.name: Sustained regime change vs transient outlier
rules.detect: A multi-day sustained level shift (illness, pregnancy, altitude move, new medication) via change-point/CUSUM — not a single-day spike
rules.action: Trigger baseline re-segmentation (new epoch) rather than clipping each day as an outlier; surface as a state change (Doc 05)
rules.effect: Avoids both weeks-long lag (suppressed) and slow poisoning of the old baseline
rules.conf: hold steady, flag the epoch boundary, raise after re-stabilisation

rules.name: Leap day / leap second / year boundary
rules.detect: Feb 29 missing/duplicated, DOY 366 off-by-one, 23:59:60 parse failure, year rollover in day-index math
rules.action: Use real date libraries; verify day counts across Feb 29 and Dec 31→Jan 1; reject leap-second fallbacks that snap to epoch
rules.effect: Stops a dropped/duplicated day shifting rolling-window & regularity alignment

rules.name: Epoch seconds/ms/µs & overflow
rules.detect: Timestamps off by 10^3/10^6 (year 1970/52000) or 32-bit overflow (1901/2038); parsed instant fails an ingestion-time range check
rules.action: Normalise epoch precision by magnitude; reject implausible parsed years; never silently coerce
rules.effect: Stops a misparsed timestamp polluting windowing & future-timestamp logic

rules.name: Altitude / cabin-pressure SpO₂ context
rules.detect: Sustained SpO₂ depression correlated with elevation gain / air travel (GPS altitude, barometer)
rules.action: Context-adjust or segment overnight SpO₂/ODI by altitude; don't let a mountain trip/flight reset the sea-level baseline
rules.effect: Stops altitude masking real desaturations or firing false ODI alarms
rules.conf: lower + tag altitude context for affected nights

rules.name: Non-random self-measurement bias
rules.detect: User-initiated spot metrics (BP, manual SpO₂, on-demand HRV) cluster with state (only when symptomatic/post-exercise) vs passive coverage
rules.action: Weight by representativeness; prefer passive continuous streams for the baseline; down-weight self-selected spot checks
rules.effect: Stops the baseline skewing toward the conditions the user chooses to measure in

rules.name: Survivorship bias from quality gates
rules.detect: Exclusion causes (non-wear, motion, partial-day) preferentially drop bad-sleep/sick/high-stress days, leaving a rosy surviving set
rules.action: Track the exclusion-cause distribution; if exclusions correlate with the metric, correct or flag the baseline as optimistic
rules.effect: Stops the gates themselves making the baseline systematically rosier than reality
rules.conf: lower when exclusion is informative (not missing-at-random)

rules.name: Seasonal/circadian drift vs trend
rules.detect: Slow periodic components (annual temperature/daylight on RHR/HRV/sleep; weekday-vs-weekend) detected by seasonal decomposition
rules.action: De-seasonalise / model day-of-week & season before trend detection; don't attribute predictable swings to baseline drift
rules.effect: Stops the EWMA chasing seasonal cycles into spurious 'improving/worsening' trends

rules.name: NaN / null / sentinel / encoding
rules.detect: null/NaN/Inf, empty arrays, magic sentinels (0,-1,255,65535,9999), or encoding artifacts (mojibake/BOM) parsed as real values
rules.action: Reject sentinels & non-finite values explicitly; never coerce null→0; treat as proper missing; validate charset
rules.effect: Stops a sentinel '0 bpm' / NaN→0 dragging medians and breaking MAD/EWMA

rules.name: Cross-metric physiological coherence
rules.detect: Impossible joint values: sleep>24h or >time-in-bed, steps>0 with flat HR & no motion, MVPA>wear-time, stages summing≠total, ODI events>recording minutes, distance≠steps×stride
rules.action: Reject/reconcile the internally inconsistent record before any metric in it contributes
rules.effect: Stops a physiologically impossible record corrupting several baselines at once
rules.conf: flag all involved metrics for that record

rules.name: Protect valid extreme individual baselines
rules.detect: Persistently extreme yet self-consistent values (RHR 32, HRV 200ms, VO₂max 80, valid hypertensive BP) that population thresholds would clip, corroborated by stable history + cross-metric coherence
rules.action: Use PERSONALISED not population bounds once individual history corroborates; don't clip a true tail toward the population mean
rules.effect: Stops aggressive population clipping miscalibrating an athlete's/hypertensive's deviation scores
